args.text:
Batch: 8 runs, 8 accepted. Flagged: none. Cleared: r01–r08.
All three final checks passed in every run: rigid-body invariance, closure and plane sections. None used the width-free ratio.
The centre REGR peak sits at 421 µm in every run. Peak REGR ranges from 52.84 to 52.92 %/h. Growth-zone length ranges from 674 to 695 µm. The largest flank difference ranges from -9.88 to -9.54 %/h, at 410–421 µm.
The large |z| for r03 and r06 comes from a very small batch spread, not from a profile of another shape. r06 kept one remedy, and its checks pass.
No flagged runs, so there is nothing common to report.
Note: r01, r04, r05 and r08 have identical checks and summaries, and so do r02 and r07. This could mean duplicated inputs and may be worth checking.
